16063694668157.seo_description: Four comedy sketch character face masks in one pack, printed on thick card with eye holes cut and elastic fitted. An easy group costume for any party.
16063694668157.descriptionHtml:
This pack of comedy sketch character face masks gives your group four of the most quoted faces from the noughties in one go. It's an easy way to theme a stag do, a hen night or a big birthday, and it gets a laugh before anyone has said a word.

Comedy Sketch Character Face Masks – 4-Pack

Inside are four masks of characters from Little Britain: Vicky Pollard, Lou Todd, Andy Pipkin and Bubbles DeVere. Each face is printed in full colour from our own artwork, cut to shape, and the eye holes are already cut out. Choose Ready to Wear and we fit the elastic and sticky tabs, or pick DIY and we send them loose to fit yourself, which keeps the price down.

Why you'll love it

  • A ready-made group costume for four, at less than the price of one shop-bought mask
  • Thick 350gsm silk card that doesn't flop or crease once it's on
  • Semi-waterproof finish, handy for beer gardens and festivals
  • Eye holes cut out for you, so nobody walks into a door
  • Made for group photos, photo booths and noughties fancy dress nights

Size & details

  • Contents: 4 masks (Vicky Pollard, Lou, Andy and Bubbles DeVere)
  • Size: each mask is 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Packaging: posted flat in a board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Only two of you going? Our Lou and Andy couple mask pair makes a brilliant double act, and these Little Britain face masks are sold one at a time too.

Please note

This is an unofficial, fan-made design inspired by Vicky Pollard, Lou Todd, Andy Pipkin and Bubbles DeVere from Little Britain. 16063694635389.descriptionHtml:
These Lou and Andy face masks are made for two friends who want to turn up as one of British comedy's best-loved double acts. One of you is the patient carer, the other is the one who always changes his mind, and the whole party will know exactly who you are the second you walk in.

Lou and Andy Face Masks – Couple Fancy Dress Pair

You get two masks in one order: Lou Todd and Andy Pipkin, the pair from the noughties sketch show Little Britain. We print each face in full colour from our own artwork, cut it to shape and cut out the eye holes, so all you do is pull on the elastic. Pick Ready to Wear and we fit the elastic and sticky tabs for you, or choose DIY and we send them loose so you can fit them yourselves.

Why you'll love it

  • A ready-made double act costume for two, with no wigs or make-up needed
  • Printed on thick 350gsm silk card that holds its shape all night
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so a spilt pint or a garden party won't ruin it
  • Pre-cut eye holes so you can see where you're going
  • Great for stag do masks, hen nights and photo booth shots

Size & details

  • Contents: 2 masks (Lou and Andy)
  • Size: each mask is 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Packaging: posted flat in a board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Fancy bringing more of the gang? Our comedy character masks come as singles too, so you can add Vicky Pollard or Bubbles DeVere for a full noughties fancy dress line-up.
